cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

mechanism: A sets symbolic prices for borrowing and stabilizing a ladder, reducing shadow hours and holding B fear to keep the borrower participating.
confusable: Unlike ordinary equal-value barter, the price is a shadow schedule and transferable fear, neither normally measurable property.
comparison: A two-favor shadow/fear trade differs from kettle repair paid with aging minutes.
seedUse: D166-a ladder, work shadow and fear; S02-a adjusts price and supplies physical help.
